description: This file contains the implementation of a singleton class 'ImmutableHeadersPlaceholder' that supports header placeholders in a headers map, providing methods for retrieving headers with support for the 'header' prefix.

classes.name: ImmutableHeadersPlaceholder
classes.description: A singleton, immutable class implementing HeadersPlaceholder, supporting header placeholder resolution from a headers map.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix string used for identifying header placeholders ('header').

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns an empty list indicating no specific supported names.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Determines if this placeholder supports a given name; always returns true for any name.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a header value from the headers map given a header key, returning an Optional containing the value if present.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the instance.
